name: policy-broker-health

graded_by.test: schema/policy/policy_test.go — policy.yaml grants broker.health per user like the other permissions; a permission name outside the six is refused

description: broker.health joins policy.yaml's permission vocabulary (session model §11: the in-surface alerts go only to a principal holding the superadmin-only permission broker.health; seeing TSB's internals is itself a permission, External_Study §1.3). It is a permission like the other five, granted per user (orchestrator DEFAULT, approval page): superadmin-only means only an admin writes policy.yaml, and how roles are defined stays OPEN (open_decisions §3). The deploy's policy template grants it to the seeded superadmin alone.
